params.message:
Show every line on Netwerk, lightly, and its own lines strongly on hover

Lines between relations were hidden until a dot was pointed at, so the
picture no longer showed who works with whom. Every line is now drawn
lightly in the colour of the busier of its two relations (the small ones'
lines fainter still). Pointing at a relation draws its lines strongly in
its own colour and fades the rest; pointing at a line shows the two
relations and how many projects they share. 3D follows the same colours.
